entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.comment: Fertilizers, plant protection products, feedingstuffs for livestock and petfood,potting soil (regardless of CN),soil improver, plant biostimulant, growing medium (excluding mineral growing medium), microbial fertilising products (included in the official list of microbial fertilising products) in the meaning of The Act on fertilisers and fertilising,
